title: On board the ferry
instructions: Feribotta yolculara yapılan anons. Süreyi, yerleri ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Good afternoon, passengers. Welcome on board the ferry to Bodrum.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Our journey today will take about one hour and forty minutes.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The café on deck two is now open. Hot food is available until thirty minutes before we arrive.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Please do not leave children alone on the outside decks.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Car passengers must return to their cars when we make the arrival announcement, not before.
